build.title: Flip the VPS Claude accounts from the console

said.text: I need to be able to flip them from the console.

brief:
# console-account-picker

Brett, Nov 5 2026 (voice): "I need to be able to flip them from the console."

## Problem
The VPS has saved Claude accounts in /root/.claude-accounts (account-1..4 subscription logins/tokens, account-5 an Anthropic API key), switched only from a shell with /usr/local/bin/claude-account (list | save | savekey | use | who). It writes /root/.claude-accounts/.token.env (CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN or ANTHROPIC_API_KEY) and copies the login to /root/.claude/.credentials.json. The console's AI keys plugin (apps/console-web/plugins/ai-keys) has its own key store and /switch, not tied to this switcher.

## Build
- In the console (AI keys page, plus a small header chip/menu), list the saved accounts with name, type (login / token / API key), email when known, and which is active. One tap switches; new builds use it, running ones keep theirs.
- Server side: call `claude-account list|use|who` (or the same file logic), never read or return a secret; last 4 at most. Add a rename/label per account (e.g. Brett Spence, Hulu API, mossesx) stored beside the account folder.
- Show status per account: a cheap test button (OK / limit hit + reset time / expired login / no credit). Never auto-run paid prompts on page load.
- Make deploy/claude-headless.sh and the other launchers (grep `claude -p`) source /root/.claude-accounts/.token.env so the console choice reaches builds. Coordinate with build-own-login (per-build login snapshot) and the ai-keys active-key logic: one source of truth, the console picker; don't break the existing ai-keys /switch.
- Tests with a fake claude-account and fake keys. Never print secrets.

Done: PR to main, report `_claude/builds/reports/console-account-picker.md`, THREADS row, orchestrator entry, readme, help text, screenshots to UI Review, hand to the merge queue (don't merge). No sub-agents, Opus only. Short plain report at the end.

steps.text: Per-build login copy and launchers: API-key and token accounts (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY / CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN), global .token.env fallback in every claude -p launcher
claude-accounts server: account types from claude-account list, labels beside the account folder, per-account status test script (OK / limit + reset / expired / no credit)
Console UI: accounts list with type, label, email, status + Test, rename; header chip shows the label; panel on the AI keys page
Limit switch follows the picker: headless builds rotate saved accounts with claude-account use first, ai-keys /switch stays the fallback
Tests with a fake claude-account and fake keys, README, help, report, screenshots to UI Review, PR to the merge queue
